totals.at_risk_rule: Per entry: largest single reduction among open findings, capped at the entry amount. Invoice: the larger of the per-entry sum and the largest invoice-level amount, capped at the sum of the lines.

findings.entry_narrative: Telephone conference with adjuster regarding initial case assessment
findings.source_quote: Time entries more than 60 days old on the invoice date will not be paid.
findings.explanation: The work is dated 2026-08-18, 79 days before the invoice date. The limit is 60 days.
findings.suggested_fix: Ask the client whether it will accept the late time, or write it off.

findings.entry_narrative: Telephone conference with adjuster regarding mediation dates
findings.source_quote: Time must be recorded in increments of 0.1 hour.
findings.explanation: 0.25 hours is not a multiple of the 0.1 hour increment.
findings.suggested_fix: Ask the timekeeper to restate the time in 0.1 hour increments from their own records.

findings.entry_narrative: Scanning and bates stamping of medical records
findings.source_quote: The Company does not pay for clerical work, training, conflicts checks or the preparation of invoices.
findings.source_ref: 5. Work the Company does not pay for, page 3
findings.explanation: The narrative contains "Scanning", which is on this client's list of non-billable clerical work.
findings.suggested_fix: Move the entry off the bill, or ask the timekeeper whether the description is accurate.

findings.entry_narrative: Postage for service copies
findings.source_quote: Overhead items such as postage, word processing, local telephone and office supplies are not reimbursable.
findings.explanation: This expense looks like an overhead item the client does not reimburse (expense code E108).
findings.suggested_fix: Remove the expense from the bill.

findings.entry_narrative: Draft index of medical records received from providers
findings.source_quote: Duplicate entries will be rejected.
findings.explanation: Same timekeeper, date, quantity and description as line 10.
findings.suggested_fix: Confirm with the timekeeper whether the work was done twice. If not, remove one entry.

findings.entry_narrative: Draft notice of deposition for store manager
findings.source_quote: Every fee entry must carry a UTBMS task code and activity code, and every expense entry must carry an expense code.
findings.explanation: The entry has no activity code.
findings.suggested_fix: Add the missing code. The timekeeper or billing staff should choose it; the check does not guess.

findings.entry_narrative: Review incident report and witness statements for coverage analysis
findings.source_quote: Only timekeepers approved in writing by the claims professional may bill time to a file.
findings.explanation: Timekeeper TK09 (Jun Castellanos-Wray) is not on the approved list for this matter.
findings.suggested_fix: Ask the client to approve the timekeeper before the bill goes out, or move the time off the bill.

findings.entry_narrative: Draft subpoena for security camera vendor records
findings.source_quote: Units times rate, plus any adjustment, must equal the line amount within one cent.
findings.source_ref: built-in file check, not a client rule
findings.explanation: 0.9 x $110.00 is $99.00, but the line amount is $109.00 (difference $10.00).
findings.suggested_fix: Correct the line in the billing system. An e-billing system is likely to reject a file that does not add up.

findings.entry_narrative: Respond to billing inquiry from adjuster on prior invoice
findings.source_quote: The Company does not pay for clerical work, training, conflicts checks or the preparation of invoices.
findings.source_ref: 5. Work the Company does not pay for, page 3
findings.explanation: The narrative contains "billing inquiry", which is on this client's list of non-billable invoice prep work.
findings.suggested_fix: Move the entry off the bill, or ask the timekeeper whether the description is accurate.

findings.entry_narrative: Research admissibility of prior incident reports
findings.rule_label: Research needs approval above a limit
findings.source_quote: Legal research exceeding 3 hours on a file requires prior approval from the claims professional.
findings.source_ref: 5. Work the Company does not pay for, page 3
findings.explanation: Research on this invoice reaches 4.2 hours with this entry (read as research from activity code A102). The limit without approval is 3 hours; 1.2 hours of this entry fall over it.
findings.suggested_fix: Ask the client to approve the research, or hold the excess time. Research billed on earlier invoices is not counted here.

findings.entry_narrative: Office conference with associate regarding deposition outline
findings.source_quote: No more than 0.3 hour may be billed for any single intra-office conference.
findings.explanation: Internal conference of 0.8 hours (read from "Office conference"). The limit is 0.3 hours per entry.
findings.suggested_fix: Reduce the entry to the limit, or ask the client to approve the longer conference.

findings.entry_narrative: Review deposition transcript of store manager; draft summary for adjuster; telephone conference with adjuster regarding reserves
findings.source_quote: Block billing is not permitted and each task must be entered separately with its own time.
findings.explanation: The narrative appears to describe 3 tasks under one time total of 3.4 hours.
findings.suggested_fix: Ask the timekeeper to enter each task on its own line with its own time. Tasks the check detected: (1) Review deposition transcript of store manager. (2) draft summary for adjuster. (3) telephone conference with adjuster regarding reserves. The tool does not know how the time divides between them and does not rewrite the narrative.

findings.entry_narrative: Draft separate statement of undisputed facts
findings.source_quote: The Company will not pay for more than 10 hours billed by one timekeeper in a single day without an explanation.
findings.explanation: This timekeeper has 10.9 hours on 2026-10-14. The limit is 10 hours in a day; 0.9 hours of this entry fall over it.
findings.suggested_fix: Confirm the day's entries with the timekeeper. If the time is right, add the explanation the client asks for or seek approval.

findings.entry_narrative: Attention to file
findings.source_quote: Vague entries such as "attention to file" or "review documents" will not be paid.
findings.explanation: The description does not say what was done. It contains "Attention to file", a phrase on the client's list of vague descriptions.
findings.suggested_fix: Ask the timekeeper to say what was reviewed or done and for what purpose. Do not fill this in for them.

findings.entry_narrative: Review documents
findings.source_quote: Vague entries such as "attention to file" or "review documents" will not be paid.
findings.explanation: The description does not say what was done. It is only "Review documents", with no subject or purpose.
findings.suggested_fix: Ask the timekeeper to say what was reviewed or done and for what purpose. Do not fill this in for them.

findings.entry_narrative: Attend deposition of plaintiff's treating physician
findings.source_quote: The Company will pay for only 1 attorney to attend a deposition, hearing or mediation unless the claims professional approves a second attendee in advance.
findings.explanation: 2 timekeepers billed for attending a deposition on 2026-10-20. The limit is 1. The check keeps the highest-rate attendee(s) and flags the rest; that choice is an assumption.
findings.suggested_fix: Decide which attendance to bill, or record the client's approval of the additional attendee.

findings.entry_narrative: Travel to deposition of plaintiff's treating physician
findings.source_quote: Travel time is billed at 50% of the approved hourly rate.
findings.source_ref: 5. Work the Company does not pay for, page 3
findings.explanation: Travel time billed at $310.00 an hour. The client pays travel at 50% of the approved rate ($155.00).
findings.suggested_fix: Bill the travel time at the reduced rate.

findings.entry_narrative: Lunch during deposition of treating physician, 1 person
findings.source_quote: Meals while traveling are reimbursed up to $50.00 per person per day and lodging up to $175.00 per night.
findings.explanation: The meal cost of $84.00 per unit is over the client's cap of $50.00.
findings.suggested_fix: Reduce the expense to the cap. The check reads each unit as one person-day (meals) or one night (lodging).

findings.entry_narrative: Draft supplemental responses to requests for production

findings.explanation: Billed at $240.00 an hour. The approved rate for this timekeeper is $225.00.

summary: Draft invoice INV-Q-1001 for Quillfeather Mutual Indemnity (matter QMI-0147) totals $13,698.90 across 42 lines. The check ran 21 confirmed client rules plus the arithmetic checks. It found 20 open findings on 19 lines: 9 will likely be rejected, 10 likely reduced and 1 for review. The amount at risk is $4,334.40, or 31.6% of the invoice, counting each line once at its largest single reduction. The most frequent issue is non-billable task categories (2 findings). 1 finding is covered by a client waiver and not counted. 2 checks could not be completed from the file; see the report. Every finding is a prompt for review; nothing on the bill has been changed.
